performance.name: Sunlit Strings — A Guitar Duet (Independent Plucks)
performance.description:
Performance: Sunlit Strings — A Guitar Duet
Description: A warm, positive acoustic duet in D major, 96 BPM, 4/4. 104 bars / 4:20.
Two Steel String Guitar — Physical Model instances: lyrical lead and alternating-thumb/strummed accompaniment.
Intro 1–8; verse 9–24; refrain 25–40; verse variation 41–56; reflective bridge 57–64; refrain 65–80; lifted final refrain 81–96; coda 97–104.
Eight MIDI lanes articulate independent strings, melody and occasional lead double-stops across only two guitars.
Background guitar feeds Master directly and send to the shared continuous Reverb Effect, whose wet output returns to Master.
Lead guitar output is routed through a Tube Amp Distorter, then to Master and Reverb.
Ends with a resolved D chord and space for the tail.

patch_definitions.name: Steel String Guitar — Independent Plucks
patch_definitions.description: Sample-free polyphonic acoustic steel-string guitar. Each note excites two fractional-delay string polarizations with frequency-dependent loss and compensated dispersion. Twelve fixed body modes, subtle per-note variation, finger/plectrum blend, pluck position and palm mute. Best E2–E6. Dry centered Stereo Output; route to Master. Settings apply to new notes. Requires Orchestron waveguide_string support; CSD exports embed the model. This edition gives each rack instance a reproducible sequence of pluck attacks and variations.

guitar_string::icutoff.expression: (2500 + 6500 * bright + 1800 * velocity + 4 * hz) / (1 + 3 * mute) + 3 * hz * mute

patch_definitions.name: Reverb Effect
patch_definitions.description: Stereo reverb effect, uses inleta channel names "left" and "right".

patch_definitions.name: Tube Overdrive
patch_definitions.description: Warm stereo tube-style saturation: biased tanh, input filtering, DC removal and tone control. Drive (0–24 dB), Tone (2–12 kHz), Output (−18 to +6 dB). Restart the rack after changing performance controls. Fully wet; use as an insert. 0 dB Drive is not bypass. No oversampling or cabinet simulation.
